title: erigeron lepidopodus
intro: Erigeron lepidopodus, commonly known as Fleshy Fleabane, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of infections and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Erigeron lepidopodus include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
